**Performance: PASS WITH NOTES** at `87f7f8b19f8e138a2207165ed5a88c035bc85b36`, graded under **C34**.

Delta from passed `633f43a`, output `8cf3c794a568b0bb82da9ce9d64c7dc94e424213`.

The writer guard adds a fixed SQL-text allocation, one Boolean bind and an `ON CONFLICT ... WHERE` predicate to the existing primary-key upsert. It adds **no SELECT, separate transaction, timer, poll or executable site**. Ordinary live-row writes short-circuit on the existing tombstone fields; preserving the same owner-close may compare its reason bytes. A refused write rolls back its event in the same transaction, preventing later resume work rather than creating a retry mechanism.

Explicit revive/spawn placement and verified reclaim use the same writer with the lift flag. No new launch path is introduced. The first close of an observed-dead/reaped row now performs one normal owner-close tombstone write/event; an already owner-closed row retains the repeat-close receipt path. These are write/close costs, not new per-tick work.

No normal-use cost breach found. The Claude marker/adopt behavior is unchanged. **C34 follow-up:** prior P200-N001, retained pre-marker identity/legacy resolver overhead; it is not a round-2 block. F151, the rare predecessor-supersede edge and pre-change custom-reason closes remain the named Known limits.

**CI:** [42558396212](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42558396212), attempt 1, Rust job `128969160824`, uploaded artifact **13648127805**, pinned to this full head: **2,313 executed passed**, zero failures/errors; five separately skipped. Verified store refused-put/no-erased-close, paused registration/close, reclaim, re-close and revive cases; six spawn guards pass. Rust lint, Node22/24 and replacement delivers succeed.

Frozen worktree/GitHub heads agree, clean/CLEAN. No local build/test, live probe, mutation or additional inventory; optional mutations are not a gate. Other roles' verdicts remain independent.
